scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter sixhuma-core --filter sixhuma-api --filter sixhuma-svelte run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --filter sixhuma-core --filter sixhuma-api --filter sixhuma-svelte run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm -r --filter sixhuma-core --filter sixhuma-api --filter sixhuma-svelte run test
